title: state gate refuses unknown gate names and non-boolean approved values
action: PBI p-94ecc5a2: `bee state gate` currently accepts an unknown --name (writing or no-oping silently) and a non-boolean --approved. Fix in set_gate.rs (follow the real handler if it spans more files): (1) an unknown --name is refused with a typed error naming the offending value AND listing the legal gate names (derive the list from the same source the write path uses — never a second hand-typed list); (2) a non-boolean --approved is refused naming the value; (3) refusal writes nothing — the gate record is byte-identical after; (4) the --merge path gets the same guards. Every currently-legal call stays byte-identical. TDD red-first: unknown name refused + store untouched; non-boolean approved refused; legal set and merge unchanged (pin one of each). Keep the whole suite green.

truths: unknown gate name refuses with the legal list and writes nothing
non-boolean approved refuses naming the value
legal gate and gate --merge calls are byte-identical to before
